# StringMatchTransformer.equals is inverted (equal iff the cases differ)
# while its hash includes the case. Two identical unions transform to two
# identical transformations: without an enum they are equal and the second
# `any` is deduplicated (a forwarding intersection, then removed); with a
# one-case enum the StringMatch makes them unequal, so both stay.
builder stm=none
prim i integer
str s unrestricted
prim b bool
uunion u1 n=Plain1
members u1 i,s,b
uunion u2 n=Plain2
members u2 i,s,b
enum e only n=E
uunion u3 n=Enum1
members u3 e,i
uunion u4 n=Enum2
members u4 e,i
enum e2 x,y n=E2
uunion u5 n=TwoCases1
members u5 e2,b
uunion u6 n=TwoCases2
members u6 e2,b
cls top a:u1,b:u2,c:u3,d:u4,e:u5,f:u6 n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
maketx csharp
fixedpoint
gc
print
